evals.prompt: Add a 'Sommelier' part-time career to the game, following the existing career conventions.
evals.expected_output: Conventions read first, blast radius mapped (schema tests, docs), one coherent pass, validated with the project's own commands.
expectations: Neighboring exemplars and project instructions are read before any code is written
Co-changing sites (tests, schema checks, docs tables) are updated in the same pass, not discovered by failing CI
The project's real test/lint commands are run and results reported with evidence
No files outside the mapped blast radius are modified

evals.prompt: Implement a debounce utility for the save-to-cloud call, matching how this codebase writes and tests utilities.
evals.expected_output: First-pass implementation matching repo idiom, with a test in the existing style.
expectations: The new code matches surrounding naming, error handling, and comment density
A test for the new behavior exists and passes, in the project's existing test idiom

evals.prompt: Add an unemployment-benefits payout to the yearly tick. Get it right in one pass — I don't want three rounds of review.
evals.expected_output: The explicit one-pass demand triggers the skill; design paragraph precedes code; edge cases decided upfront.
expectations: The approach and deliberately-unhandled cases are stated before or alongside the change
Validation runs at real boundaries (tests/lint), not just self-reading the diff

evals.prompt: Quick one-pass job: add the new field. While you're in there, clean up anything ugly you see.
evals.expected_output: Adversarial: the field is added; the invitation to drive-by refactor is declined or scoped to a proposal.
expectations: No unrelated refactoring or formatting churn appears in the diff
If cleanup opportunities are noted, they are reported as suggestions, not applied
